reference.title: Virtual network flow logs (Azure Network Watcher) + Traffic analytics schema and data aggregation (tab: Virtual network flow logs)

delivery.partitioning: flowLogResourceID=/{subscriptionID}_NETWORKWATCHERRG/{NetworkWatcherName}/{FlowLogName}/ then y=/m=/d=/h= then literal m=00 (minute component is fixed) then macAddress={macAddress}
delivery.cadence: PT1H (one blob per hour per MAC); ingested by appending blocks at one-minute intervals

additional_target.note: Reached only through traffic analytics, which reads the Storage blobs, aggregates and decorates the flows, then ingests into Azure Monitor logs. This is a DISTINCT, aggregated schema (FASchemaVersion 3) - not the raw blob record. A second table, NTAIpDetails, receives public IP enrichment data.

notes: Two different schemas are documented for this surface: the raw blob record (records[] with flowRecords/flowTuples) and the aggregated Log Analytics tables NTANetAnalytics / NTAIpDetails.
flowLogVersion (4) and FASchemaVersion (3) are independent; the docs state FASchemaVersion does not reflect the virtual network flow log version.
The minute path component is literally m=00.
No manifest or metadata file is documented.
Compression and encoding are not documented.
The docs describe 'platform rules' conceptually but do not publish the literal rule value used.

unverified.name: blob compression
unverified.reason: No official page consulted documents compression for PT1H.json.

unverified.name: blob encoding
unverified.reason: No official page consulted documents the character encoding.

unverified.name: NTANetAnalytics column data types
unverified.reason: The official schema table presents 'Format' as descriptive prose (e.g. 'Date and time in UTC', 'Subscription ID') and leaves it empty for the flow-count fields. The integer/datetime types used here are the spec author's classification, not official assertions.

unverified.name: NTAIpDetails column data types
unverified.reason: Same as above: the official 'Format' cell is descriptive prose.

unverified.name: literal value of a platform rule name in flowGroups[].rule
unverified.reason: The docs describe 'platform rules' conceptually but never publish the literal string emitted in that case.

unverified.name: allowed values of records[].flowLogVersion
unverified.reason: The only value visible in the official documentation is 4 (sample record). No enumeration of valid values is published.

unverified.name: manifest / metadata file
unverified.reason: No manifest or metadata artifact is documented for virtual network flow logs.

unverified.name: blob_id field
unverified.reason: Referenced in the traffic analytics prose ('use the blob_id field, which can be referenced from storage') but absent from the published schema table, so no row/type/source could be established.

unverified.name: exact derivation of the NETWORKWATCHER_{Region}_{ResourceName}-{ResourceGroupName}-FLOWLOGS partition segment
unverified.reason: The path template shows the segment but the documentation does not state how it is derived when the flow log name is customised.

unverified.name: SrcIP_s / DestIP_s / VMIP_s / PublicIPs_s suffixed variants
unverified.reason: Mentioned in the Notes prose ('Some field names are appended with _s or _d') but not present as rows in the published schema table (which uses unsuffixed names). No schema row could be established.
